content:
maya: Heads-up  Aurora Health pilot completed on Redwood Dedicated. Product asks for a short customer spotlight + 30m webinar. Need quote + logo sign-off and legal clearance (HIPAA).
leo: sweet. any perf numbers we can share?
samir: internal test showed median latency ~110ms steady-state and cost down ~45%, but customer wants to OK numbers.
anika: i'll draft conservative quote options and request logo.
maya: draft A (specific): "Aurora Health: Redwood Dedicated cut our median latency to ~110ms and reduced inference costs by ~45%, enabling live clinician workflows."
draft B (high level): "Aurora Health: Redwood Dedicated reduced our inference latency and infrastructure costs, enabling new clinician-facing features."
olivia: send B first, offer gated appendix for the numbers. legal will require DPA mention.
legal-bot: Requirements: no PHI in assets, require written email approval for quote/logo usage, and reference DPA for processing.
maya: sent B + logo request + asked about sanitized graph PNG.
aurora-rep: (customer) We approve the high-level quote and will provide a logo. We will not permit dashboard animations; PNG is OK. Also want to review final blog before publish.
ops: can produce a redacted latency chart PNG. ETA tomorrow.
legal-bot: Approve publishing draft B once customer confirms via email and signs off on assets. Include logo license clause.
leo: scheduling webinar rehearsal next Tue, will draft run-of-show.
maya: received customer's approval email and logo. Dr. Patel confirmed as speaker (15m talk + 10m q&a).
samir: updating quote to match legal edits: "Aurora Health: Redwood Dedicated reduced our inference latency and lowered infrastructure costs, enabling new clinician-facing features."
maya: final copy sent to customer for last read. assets uploaded to shared drive. aiming to publish in 9 business days.
anolivia: :tada: locking thread for approvals. will add to content calendar when live.
maya: thanks team. keeping this thread as canonical for the Aurora spotlight.
